title.narrative: Herramientas de resiliencia pesquera artesanal del Caribe Sur costarricense en el contexto de la pandemia por COVID-19

description.narrative: The COVID-19 pandemic dramatically reduced artisanal fisherfolks ability to earn an income and support their families along Costa Ricas Caribbean coast, as the region suffered from lower tourism and limited access to fishing areas and markets. Across the Caribbean, artisanal fishing livelihoods have been further threatened by the increased presence of the invasive lionfish, which can decimate native fish populations. The IAF supports community-led approaches to natural resource management and income generation. Our grantee Asociacin de Pescadores Artesanales del Caribe Sur (ASOPACS) will work with its members to establish a cooperative business model for seafood sales to overcome the hurdles caused by the pandemic. ASOPACS is also engaging with community organizations throughout the Caribbean to coordinate a regional response to the invasive lionfish population. This grant is part of the IAF's broader COVID-19 response strategy.
